title: Format Money
description: Money is stored as whole paise. Write `rupees(paise)` returning text like `'Rs 1,234.56'`. Negative amounts look like `'-Rs 5.00'`.
solution_code:
def rupees(paise):
    sign = '-' if paise < 0 else ''
    paise = abs(paise)
    return f"{sign}Rs {paise // 100:,}.{paise % 100:02d}"
